issue: Four Pump create/extend differential runners read the captured Pump and Mayhem images, the captured config snapshot and the dependency ELFs, then truncated --output with write_bytes. Passing an input as --output destroyed captured evidence, or replaced the executing runner with its own report.
affected: scripts/pump_create_quote_differential.py, scripts/pump_create_v2_differential.py, scripts/pump_create_mayhem_differential.py, scripts/pump_extend_differential.py at base; each writer is the last statement of its main block
finding: Base run of the new test: 15 failing subtests in 4 of 5 tests. --output on the captured Pump or Mayhem image overwrote it, and --output on the runner itself replaced the module with the report. Their admitted siblings pump_create_differential.py and pump_global_init_differential.py already publish through scripts/pump_differential_output.py: PumpReport.

change.publisher: PumpReport(output, ROOT, candidate, __file__, extra_inputs=[...]) built before any case executes and before pin_program
change.report_inputs: the captured evidence/original/mayhem/deployed.so for the three create runners (create_mayhem additionally protects both candidate paths, --candidate-pump and --candidate-mayhem); pump_extend reads only inputs the publisher already protects
change.failure: ValueError: report output aliases an input: <path>, exit 1, before a case runs and before any output directory is created

runs.case_payload_unchanged: base and proposed runners produced gzip receipts that are identical after ignoring script_sha256: create_quote 297 cases, create_v2 110, extend 308, create_mayhem 17, all with no mismatches
runs.alias_refusals: 15 refusals exercised by the new test (captured Pump image, captured Mayhem image where it is an input, captured config snapshot, executing script); each exits non-zero with the alias message and leaves the target bytes unchanged
runs.publication_control: each runner publishes a fresh nested gzip receipt: mismatch-free JSON, non-empty cases, and no staging file left beside it

tests.before: 15 failing subtests in 4 of 5 tests against the base scripts (65.6s)

required_checks.tests.test_pump_create_cashback_output_p: 9 tests OK; the same 2 setUpClass errors occur on the base revision (missing local build inputs), unchanged

unchanged: captured images, dependency ELFs and config snapshot
report schema, indentation and gzip mtime pinning
